title: Demand Generation Manager, Sales Enablement Focus
description:
Overview

Douglas Adams once said, "Technology is a word that describes something that doesn\'t work yet." Funny, because it\'s true — so much so that it sparked our unrelenting mission to increase the positive impact of technology on people\'s lives.

From robot vacuums and voice assistants to banking apps, smart toys, and backyard grills, Centercode has helped shape countless products in virtually every household — and chances are good we\'ve impacted your life already. We\'re full of people who take pride in striving toward our goals and having a blast while doing it. We\'re always on the lookout for enthusiastic, like-minded people to join us in making everyday life better through technology.

As a Demand Generation Manager , you\'ll be the engine that fuels Centercode\'s growth— generating awareness that turns curiosity into conversations, conversations into opportunities, and opportunities into evangelists. You\'ll own and optimize the earliest stage of our revenue funnel, building programs that spark interest, and convert inbound leads into qualified meetings. You\'ll also manage our communities and mobilize Centercode Advocates. Working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and partners, you\'ll craft scalable initiatives and arm our teams with the tools and resources they need to accelerate pipeline progression.

What You\'ll Do

  • Demand Generation: Design and manage HubSpot multi-channel campaigns driving MQLs and pipeline growth, supporting ABM campaign frameworks and owning pipeline growth by optimizing lead scoring, nurturing workflows, and conversion metrics
  • Program Execution: Coordinate lead engagement around Centercode\'s online communities and events, including trade shows, summits, webinars, and LinkedIn Live, ensuring optimized Hubspot sequences and proper lead routing, and managing onboarding for sales enablement
  • Sales Enablement Content: Create and maintain sales enablement materials including: Persona-based messaging and talk tracks, ROI one-pagers, case studies, and customer success stories
  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with Sales and Marketing to define enablement needs across prospecting, qualification, and closing stages

What You Need to Do the Job

  • 4+ years experience in B2B demand generation, with at least 2 years in sales enablement or a closely aligned role
  • Strong understanding of the SaaS sales cycle and qualification frameworks
  • Experience converting leads to opportunities in the SaaS space
  • Excellent writing, research, and communication skills for lead conversion
  • A self-starting mindset for building new processes from scratch
  • CRM Proficiency (HubSpot preferred) and experience with AI tools

What\'ll Give You an Edge

  • Prior experience in beta testing, insights, or crowdsource technology space
  • Strong knowledge of marketing automation workflows and advanced HubSpot capabilities
  • Experience partnering directly with sales teams to design campaigns that accelerate pipeline velocity
  • Success with engaging communities with content and events
  • Proven success driving multi-channel demand campaigns with measurable ROI
  • A background in data-driven marketing
  • Experience thriving in fast-paced, high-growth environments

The Nitty Gritty

  • This is a full-time, remote position
  • Candidate must live in the United States
  • Candidate must be willing and able to travel up to 10%
  • Sorry, Recruiters: We\'re not open to working with you on this role
  • We require a satisfactory background check following offer acceptance

More About Us

Centercode is a highly innovative tech company and we\'re growing all the time. Our weird and wonderful work culture is unified by geeking out hard over tech — the old, the new, and the yet-to-exist. We value adaptability over perfectionism and productivity over long hours. Also, towels. They\'re very important to us.

You\'ll Fit Right In If

  • You love emerging tech — using it, talking about it, tinkering with it
  • You\'re obsessed with using AI to amplify your productivity
  • You\'re not afraid to ask (or answer) stupid questions
  • You\'re a strong communicator but your an even better listener
  • You were triggered by the grammar in that last bullet
  • Your coworkers speak highly of you and your work
  • You know your biggest weakness — and it isn\'t that you\'re a perfectionist
  • You\'re a Builder with a track record to prove it
  • You\'re willing to admit when you screw up (it happens to the best of us)
  • You know the answer to the Ultimate Question

The Typical Perks You’d Expect

  • Medical + FSA
  • Voluntary Dental + Vision
  • 3 weeks of PTO annually (plus more the longer you\'re with the company)
  • 401k matching
  • Other Voluntary Insurance: life, disability, pet, etc.

Plus a Few Pleasant Surprises

  • We pay for your phone (unlimited data!)

title: Senior Underwriter
description:
Overview

Position Summary: The Senior Mortgage Underwriter is responsible for evaluating residential loan applications to ensure sound credit decisions in accordance with investor guidelines, regulatory requirements, and company policies. This role serves as a subject matter expert in complex loan scenarios, provides mentorship to junior underwriters, and supports cross-functional collaboration to drive operational excellence, risk mitigation, and superior service delivery.

Qualifications

  • College degree in business, finance, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of mortgage underwriting experience.
  • FHA Direct Endorsement (DE) certification with at least two (2) years of FHA underwriting experience required.
  • VA Credit/SAR authority with a minimum of two (2) years of VA underwriting experience required or in progress.
  • Experience underwriting a variety of loan products, including Bond, Jumbo, USDA, and other specialty programs (minimum of two years).
  • Strong knowledge of agency, investor, and regulatory underwriting standards (FNMA, FHLMC, FHA, VA, USDA).
  • Certification as a Mortgage Underwriter preferred.
  • Excellent analytical, credit evaluation, and decision-making skills with a focus on detail and accuracy.
  • Proficient in loan origination systems (e.g., Encompass) and automated underwriting tools.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work both independently and in a collaborative environment.
  • Proven ability to meet deadlines and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced setting.

Essential Job Functions

  • Underwrite residential mortgage loan files within delegated authority, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and adherence to guidelines.
  • Analyze borrower income, credit, assets, liabilities, and collateral to determine risk and loan eligibility.
  • Assess appraisal reports and property valuations to confirm loan-to-value (LTV) and property eligibility.
  • Issue clear and well-supported decisions, including approvals, counteroffers, suspensions, and denials.
  • Maintain compliance with all applicable federal and state laws, agency/investor guidelines, and internal policies.
  • Meet or exceed established service level agreements (SLAs) for underwriting turn times.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior underwriters and support staff.
  • Collaborate with loan officers, processors, and closers to resolve conditions and expedite loan decisions.
  • Identify potential fraud indicators, misrepresentation, or red flags, and escalate appropriately.
  • Support quality control and audit readiness by ensuring documentation and data integrity.
  • Stay informed of changes in underwriting guidelines, industry best practices, and regulatory developments.
  • Accurately document underwriting decisions and maintain system records with complete audit trails.
  • Deliver exceptional customer service to internal teams and external partners to enhance the loan experience.
  • Participate in special projects or initiatives as assigned.

Company Description

Yuna's mission is to radically transform the way mental health support is accessed and delivered. By providing 24/7 instant and private support at the push of a button, we aim to address the significant gaps in mental health care accessibility. In a system where waiting times for therapists can reach up to 48 days and many people can't even afford care, Yuna is the answer to immediate mental health support needs.

We’re growing quickly, and every person who joins us plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of mental health technology.

Position Overview

You’ll own Yuna’s core conversational intelligence (i.e., spanning retrieval, memory, safety, evaluation, and post-training). You’ll ship user-visible improvements quickly while raising the bar on empathy, reliability, and guardrails. This is a hands-on staff-level role: equal parts research-to-production and platform thinking.

What you’ll do

  • Lead the end-to-end model lifecycle of Yuna’s conversational AI: problem framing → data curation → modeling/fine-tuning/post-training → evals → rollout → monitoring
  • Work closely with clinical psychologists (both internal and external to Yuna), ensuring the efficacy of Yuna’s conversational AI
  • Design agentic flows (tool use, planning, multi-turn memory) and safe retrieval for mental-health use cases
  • Build and own the evaluation flywheel: benchmarks, judge models, rubrics for conversational quality, ability to help, safety
  • Implement alignment & safety layers (e.g., self-harm detection, red-teaming, refusal strategies, escalation paths) tuned to clinical guidelines
  • Optimize for latency, cost, and quality
  • Partner tightly with product, sales, and users to scope new features
  • Establish LLMOps: datasets, prompts/checkpoints/versioning, observability, drift monitoring, and incident response for model quality

What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years in ML/AI with 3+ shipping LLM/NLP systems in production
  • Deep skill in Python and modern deep learning stacks (PyTorch/JAX/TensorFlow), retrieval/RAG, embeddings, reranking, and long-context summarization
  • Experience building agentic systems (tool calling, decomposition, memory) and rigorous eval harnesses (offline + online)
  • Strong product sense; you care about user outcomes, not just model metrics
  • Comfort working with ambiguity and creating systems 0 to 1

Location and Employment Type

Location: Remote (work from anywhere, with at least 6 hours overlap with PST)

Employment Type: Full Time

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (based on experience) + equity options
  • Remote-first culture with flexibility
  • A fast-growing, talented, and empathetic team dedicated to transforming mental health care
  • The opportunity to make a real impact on the world, building cutting-edge AI systems that improve lives every day

title: Backend Cloud Engineer — Aws Serverless (Remote)
description:
Overview

everup provides instant cashback on purchases of gift cards from top brands and offers the excitement of winning extra cashback through free and engaging games. Our mission is to extend consumer budgets during rising living costs, blending savings with enjoyment. We offer prize-linked digital branded prepayments and turn shopping into opportunities. everup is a unique gamified shopping experience in the branded prepaid and curated goods market, helping customers save money while bringing entertainment and excitement.

The role

You’ll work across our event-driven, serverless stack to maintain and evolve production systems. That means adding features, fixing bugs, improving performance and cost, tightening security, and raising reliability—while collaborating closely with Mobile / Web.

Responsibilities

  • Maintain and evolve AWS Lambda microservices behind Amazon API Gateway (HTTP / REST & WebSocket) and AWS IoT Core; implement authentication / authorization via Cognito User Pools (JWT) and Lambda authorizers for REST / HTTP.
  • Maintain and optimize data models and access patterns in DynamoDB and MySQL (RDS); handle indexes, migrations, and query performance.
  • Maintain asynchronous workflows using SQS / SNS (idempotency, DLQs, retries) and keep observability healthy with CloudWatch metrics / logs and alarms.
  • Maintain and improve our IaC (AWS SAM / CloudFormation), CI / CD pipelines, and environment promotions.
  • Integrate and support third-party services used for payments, open banking, notifications, fraud / risk, analytics and support tooling.
  • Troubleshoot production issues, drive RCAs, and implement preventive fixes and runbooks.
  • Uphold security best practices (least-privilege IAM, secret management, input validation, auditability).

Tech you’ll touch

AWS Lambda, API Gateway (REST / WebSocket), Cognito, DynamoDB, RDS MySQL, SQS / SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, CloudFormation / SAM, EC2, ECS, plus fintech / comms integrations (Open Banking / PSP, Gift Cards, Analytics, Messaging, Support, and Risk assessment tools).

Must-haves

  • 8+ years building / maintaining production backends; 4+ years with AWS serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB).
  • Proficiency in JavaScript / Node.js; strong REST API fundamentals and event-driven patterns.
  • Solid SQL / NoSQL skills (schema design, indexing, query tuning).
  • Experience maintaining IaC (SAM / CloudFormation) and CI / CD (Code Pipeline).
  • Security-first mindset and practical debugging / troubleshooting chops (OWASP).
  • WebSocket / API Gateway connection management and real-time features.
  • Payments / fintech and fraud / risk integrations.
  • Observability practices (dashboards, tracing, log correlation) and SLOs.
  • Elastic Beanstalk familiarity and data pipelines / warehousing exposure.

How we work

Remote-first within UK time zone, startup-paced, with high ownership. We value clean code, small safe changes, and excellent operability.

Hiring process

  1. Intro call
  2. Technical deep-dive (systems design discussions focused on maintainability and evolution)
  3. Practical walkthrough (IaC / API / data-modeling maintenance scenario)
  4. Founder / lead chat & references

Equal opportunity

We’re an equal-opportunity employer and welcome every background and perspective.

How to apply

⦿ When applying, please include the following in your CV / application :

  • A link to your CV, GitHub, or portfolio.
  • A short note describing a production backend you maintained or evolved, and the reliability or cost improvements you delivered.
  • Your current salary or expected monthly salary (in EUR).
  • Your notice period.
  • Confirmation of your availability to work at least 6 hours per day aligned with EU time zones.

⚠️ Applications that do not include the above details will not be considered.

Thank you for your interest — we look forward to your application!

description:
About the role

As a Technical Account Manager, you will play a key role in delivering strategic services and support to Riskifield's clients, ensuring their success and maximizing the value of our solutions.

Riskifield's clients come in many shapes and sizes, span multiple software platforms, and each one has its own unique story and internal flows. The Technical Account Manager will be working cross-functionally to assist our merchants in scaling up the technical aspects of our products.

Externally, you’ll be working with brand-name retailers who are looking to reduce online fraud rates and increase their bottom line by optimizing, improving, and enhancing their current Riskified services.

Internally, you'll collaborate daily with various departments, including Product, Account Management, Analytics, Data Science, and Development, to ensure all relevant aspects of the product life cycle are addressed, being one of the primary points of contact of the Integrations team.

The end goal of the Technical Account Manager is to own the technical aspects of integration efforts, upsells, and cross-sales to accelerate our merchants’ growth.

Serve as the main technical focal point for Riskified’s enterprise merchants, leading upsells, cross-sales, and other efforts.

Analyze clients’ requirements and business needs from technical and functional perspectives and fit solutions by having a deep understanding of our system and products’ capabilities.

Build, monitor, and execute joint project plans with clients.

Proactively initiate and design process improvements, tools, features, and product enhancements.

3 Key Areas to Focus

Technical Expertise & Troubleshooting:

  • Log analysis.
  • Troubleshooting complex technical issues.
  • Demonstrate how you've analyzed client requirements and resolved multi-layered challenges in past roles.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Project Management:

  • Emphasize your experience working with diverse teams—including Product, Account Management, and Development—to build and execute joint project plans.

Client Engagement & Business Acumen:

title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
For Brazil Only, PJ contract, Fluent English

Position : Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer

Location : Brazil (Remote)

Work Hours : Must have overlap with U.S. Central Time

Start Date : Immediate

Contract Type : PJ (Pessoa Jurídica)

Duration : 3-4 months

Language Requirement : Fluent English required ( U.S.-based company)

Summary

We’re looking for an experienced QA Engineer who ramps up quickly on complex business domains and turns that understanding into clear, risk-based test strategies. You’ll combine strong manual testing skills with proven test case design and automation in .NET (C#) to raise the bar on quality across web, API, and data flows. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and DevOps to deliver reliable, testable, and observable software continuously.

What You’ll Do

  • Translate business processes into tests : Rapidly learn product / domain concepts and map endtoend workflows into highvalue test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
  • Design and execute test suites : Build and maintain comprehensive manual and automated tests (UI, API, integration, regression, smoke, and exploratory).
  • Build .NET automation : Develop and maintain C# test automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright , Selenium WebDriver , SpecFlow BDD , NUnit / xUnit / MSTest ) aligned to SOLID and POM principles.
  • Enable CI / CD quality gates : Integrate automated tests into pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps , GitHub Actions ) with parallel runs, test reporting, and flaky-test management.
  • Collaborate across disciplines : Work with Product Owners to refine acceptance criteria, with Developers to shift-left quality, and with business users to validate in staging / preproduction environments and in production once deployed.
  • Own defect lifecycle : Identify, document, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, screenshots, and impact.
  • Data & API validation : Test APIs, validate payloads and contracts (e.g., via Swagger / OpenAPI ), and verify database outcomes ( SQL Server ).
  • Non-functional checks : Contribute to performance baselines (e.g., k6 , JMeter ), and security test coordination.
  • Test strategy & traceability : Maintain risk-based test plans, coverage maps, and traceability to requirements / ACs.
  • Mentor & improve : Share best practices, pair on tests, and improve standards for reliability, maintainability, and observability of tests.

Must Have Qualifications

  • Software quality assurance experience, including extensive manual testing and test case design.
  • Proficiency in building and maintaining automated tests in .NET (C#) for UI and / or API layers.
  • Strong understanding of .NET / .NET Core , ASP.NET (MVC / Web API) fundamentals, HTTP, and JSON.
  • Hands-on with Selenium and / or Playwright , plus NUnit / xUnit / MSTest ; experience.
  • Comfortable reading application code, using Visual Studio / Visual Studio Code , debugging tests, and collaborating on testability.
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or GitHub for source control, boards / issues, and CI / CD pipelines.

  • Melhorar a gestão de caixa e o índice de capital de giro.
  • Promover a cultura de ética e integridade nos negócios na equipe, assegurando o adequado conhecimento e cumprimento dos princípios de ética e integridade, políticas da empresa e códigos de conduta que regulam o mercado farmacêutico.

Sobre você

  • Experiência: Experiência em Gestão de Categorias e Strategic Sourcing.
  • Competências técnicas e pessoais: A posição requer um profissional de sourcing capaz de desenvolver relacionamentos dentro e entre as diferentes linhas de negócios e em toda a organização de compras; forte conhecimento dos processos de RFx (RFI/RFP/RFQ); histórico comprovado de liderança de negociações comerciais e jurídicas; forte compreensão de contratos legais; experiência em ferramentas de eSourcing e eProcurement (SAP/ERP); trabalho em equipe com excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais; experiência em gestão de projetos e contratos locais; conhecimento intermediário de finanças e análise de custos.

A Medley, unidade de negócios de genéricos da Sanofi, tem como foco democratizar o acesso à saúde no Brasil, desenvolvendo soluções voltadas principalmente para cardiologia, saúde feminina, doenças do sistema nervoso central e gastroenterologia. Uma das nossas prioridades é melhorar a experiência das pessoas em suas jornadas de saúde, oferecendo conteúdos relevantes, campanhas educativas e serviços de apoio. A Medley é patrocinadora do Comitê Olímpico do Brasil e apoia o esporte e a saúde dos brasileiros.

Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade. Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 16.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

Colaboradores que consigam criar um ambiente em que todos sejam motivados a dar o seu melhor a fim de que a organização alcance seus objetivos. Se você está sempre buscando novas maneiras de crescer e enfrentar desafios, se trabalha no desenvolvimento de pessoas capazes de conquistar suas metas profissionais além das metas da organização, a SIG tem um lugar para você. Para entregar o melhor aos nossos clientes, nossos colegas constroem uma forte relação com eles e trabalham para apresentar as soluções de que eles precisam. Por fim, estamos buscando pessoas que sejam capazes de construir parcerias e trabalhar de maneira colaborativa rumo ao alcance dos objetivos comuns. Caso se junte a nós, você fará parte de uma organização internacional de sucesso global: a líder do segmento em sustentabilidade, tecnologia e inovação. Nós nos enxergamos como uma pista de decolagem de uma carreira;
um lugar de rápido desenvolvimento pessoal e profissional, com trabalho, experiências e oportunidades reais de se adquirir novas habilidades. title: Analista de conciliação
description: Empresa desenvolvedora de Soluções, prestadora de serviços para aproximadamente 6 mil clientes e em pleno desenvolvimento está em busca de profissionais atentos, comprometidos e com olhar diferenciado na organização de processos para um desafio inovador dentro do departamento de Conciliação.  Responsabilidades  Realizar conciliação do contas a receber diariamente e estruturar base de dados a conciliar diariamente;  Manter sistema atualizado com as baixas financeiras, tributárias e de possíveis descontos/glosas, fornecendo informações fidedignas e rastreáveis;  Contatar clientes via telefone ou e-mail para obter relatórios com composição de pagamentos;  Resolver demandas no fluxo do time de conciliação, fiscal e contábil, procurando apoiar na resolução integral dos saldos a receber da companhia;  Analisar documentos e relatórios para identificar soluções ou inconformidades para regularizar lançamentos financeiros, fiscais e contábeis;  Realizar fechamentos de saldos do Contas a Receber, comparando-os com saldos das escriturações contábeis e fiscais;  Auditar e requisitar devoluções de pagamentos;  Prestar contas à contabilidade, controladoria e financeiro.  Qualificações  Para isso, precisamos de pessoas que possuam Graduação completa em Ciências Contábeis, Pacote Office Intermediário, Conhecimento em Legislação Tributária e Retenção de Impostos, Conhecimento em Contabilidade, Conhecimento em Excel e Lógica.  Benefícios  Nessa jornada conosco poderá contar com:   Vale Refeição ou Alimentação.   Cartão multibeneficios.
